dominant_strengths: Clear feature taxonomy via four equal cards with distinct icons that immediately communicate the AI product surface area.
Warm peach demo canvas contrasts cleanly with neutral chrome, drawing focus to the Q&A agent storytelling moment.
Annotation overlay (Jason + Q&A bubble) demonstrates the feature in-situ rather than abstractly, raising behavioral clarity.
dominant_weaknesses: Four feature cards feel generic and undifferentiated — same weight, same icon size, no hierarchy to signal which matters most.
The cropped table beneath the chat overlay is visually noisy with many faint rows competing for attention against the highlighted row.
Iconography is flat blue-glyph stock style, lacking the bespoke craft expected from a flagship AI launch page.
fix_priorities: Introduce hierarchy among the four pillars — vary scale, add a primary anchor, or sequence them with progressive disclosure.
Tighten the demo crop so the highlighted Q&A row is the unambiguous focal point, fading or masking adjacent rows further.
Replace generic glyph icons with custom illustrative marks tied to Notion's visual language for distinctiveness.
Add subtle motion or scroll-linked reveal cues since this is a scroll feature module, currently reads static.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity leads via the annotated demo, but visceral spark and reflective 'wow' are muted by generic card treatment.
rationale.intent_fit: It legibly presents Notion AI's pillars and a concrete agent demo, fitting the scroll-section brief but without memorable distinction.
